title: Evaluation study of subproject 1 MOVE-ME/CFS-BW
summary: The MOVE-ME/CFS-BW research project is a collaborative project between the University Medical Centre Freiburg and the university hospitals in Heidelberg, Tübingen, Ulm, Offenburg and Stuttgart. The clinics' outpatient departments provide standardised, interprofessional care for patients with post-viral syndromes in childhood and adolescence. The care provided includes diagnosis and treatment as well as appropriate follow-up care and networking in the outpatient sector. As part of the evaluation study, qualitative and quantitative methods are used to assess the experiences of service providers and recipients with regard to the care offered. Based on these experiences, a best practice toolbox is being created to aid in the further development of the care services.
conditions: Investigation of the quality of care in outpatient clinics for patients with post-viral syndromes

Inclusion criteria:
Only individuals who have given their informed consent to participate in the evaluation study will be included in the study. Inclusion criteria for participation in the study are sufficient knowledge of the German language to be able to complete the questionnaires and participate in qualitative interviews. Only families with a confirmed diagnosis will be included.
